status: Implemented. ENOSPC regressions, negative control, full component matrix and upstream Linux checks pass. No qualification credit.

bug.trigger: A durable state transaction reaches actual ENOSPC during commit.
bug.before: MDBX aborts and releases the failed transaction. The Rust wrapper propagates the error before marking its pointer ended. The synchronized pointer destructor submits another abort and panics on BadTxn.
bug.after: Record the ended handle before returning the original error, except MDBX_THREAD_MISMATCH. The writer returns error 28, closes publication, preserves its prior snapshot and can reopen/replay after space is freed.
bug.native_contract: signet-mdbx-sys 0.1.0 libmdbx/mdbx.h, mdbx_txn_commit: every result except MDBX_THREAD_MISMATCH ends the transaction.

patch.scope: Both synchronized and unsynchronized commit error paths. The existing success completion marker and transaction manager are unchanged. No native MDBX, wire or stored-format change.
patch.removal: Use an upstream release with equivalent cleanup only after the same commit failure and normal-commit checks pass.

test.isolation: One owned Linux Docker container per parent test, network disabled, no added capabilities. The real test executable and shared libraries are mounted read-only. An eight-MiB tmpfs holds authoritative state; the parent has a 120-second execution bound and removes its container.
test.data: Two small blocks and a one-MiB code payload; actual kernel ENOSPC before commit.
assertions: Failed commit returns error 28 without a panic or new snapshot.
Reopen preserves block/account/storage/cursors and excludes the failed header/code/receipt/hash index.
Free space and replay the failed batch; require exact resulting code, account, storage and receipt/index.
Unsynchronized commit preserves the old value, excludes the failed new value and succeeds on retry.
test.limitation: The unsynchronized test does not directly count abort calls. No EIO, power loss, trie mode, process supervision, full executor receipt publication or whole-chain recovery proof.

validation.binding_host_all_features: 210 unit/integration/property tests and 14 doctests passed; one upstream doctest ignored.
validation.style: just style passes; the existing proc-macro-error2 future-incompatibility notice remains.
validation.catalog_and_runner: One catalog registry check and eight component runner contract tests pass.
validation.binding_linux: The published Dockerfile passes nightly formatting, both clippy feature sets with -D warnings, and both test feature sets: 448 passed, two ignored upstream doctest executions. Source hashes match the local patch.
validation.binding_rustdoc: cargo doc --locked --no-deps with RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings passes.

performance.limitations: Existing 25MB account-only SafeNoSync microbenchmark on a shared host. Not deployed client latency/throughput, durable fsync performance, or proof of a speedup.

service_wiring: No service placement, configuration or publication wiring change. The workspace uses the pinned patched binding through a Cargo path patch.
hot_path: Commit cleanup is on the state write path. The new helper runs only for errors. The existing 25MB account-only SafeNoSync benchmark shows no measured slowdown; it is not deployed latency/throughput validation and does not prove a speedup.
